why: The statement is one universal claim over all automorphic L-functions. Proportion-on-the-line results (Wu, Sono, Alpöge–Furman, Lamzouri, Knausgård, Hua–Yang, Johns, Conrey et al.) and zero-free regions (Thorner–Zhao, OpenAI family 003) move quantities without deciding any L-function's zeros, so they are bound. Conditional results (Basak et al., Dong et al. twice) are none, Lu–Zaman–Zhao is instances, Brent is a critique (none), and Math Inc's function-field RH is a variant. Claimed RH proofs for ζ are case and claimed RH disproofs are whole-refuting, but all of them carry several F10 signals or were withdrawn or refuted. Zhang's grand-RH claim is not_credible: scope grew between versions, there are many versions, and nobody has taken it up. AI: Alpöge–Furman and Johns are generated on explicit quotes. The OpenAI items are generated on the repository's general attribution. Lamzouri and Knausgård credit no system in their own events.
doubts: The OpenAI attribution is a close call. The README says the zero-free-region work for zeta was an exception to the fixed procedure, so the human role in the 7/8 paper is unclear. I answered generated because the repository credits the model and names no human mathematician. openai-math-003 duplicates the 7/8 and 11/12 events. For Alpöge–Furman, Conrey and Goldston examined the paper only per Anthropic's own report, which I did not treat as digestion. Zhang's text was never read. Math Inc and Zhang's RH preprint are undated.
